name: Frost Titan
primary:
A giant frost titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either fires ice shards at up to 3 foes: damage 3 ❤ cold, cold 60, chill;
or slams the ground with both fists, which freezes the ground within 3 blocks; everyone within 5 blocks takes 3 ❤ cold, cold 80 and a strong chill.
self_description:
On you:
• Stone skin (resistance III), 15 s
• Cold 60
